predictions.articleTitle: Roasso Kumamoto vs Kitakyushu Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Set-Piece Edge vs Leaky Defense

possibilityAssessment: Roasso Kumamoto hold the primary win route via set-piece conversion and Kitakyushu's 1.59 goals conceded per J3 match, while Draw covers Kumamoto's midfield absences and three-match conceding slide (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Over 2.5 goals and BTTS Yes align with Kitakyushu's 1.47 goals-per-game attack, zero clean sheets in six sampled matches, and Kumamoto's recent November open-game trend (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
